patterns.name: Fixed white top bar
patterns.description: 72px bar (70px + 2px bottom rule that turns #e5e5e5 once the page scrolls, border-color 0.3s ease). Logo left, uppercase 'site language' trigger right; past the hero the trigger is replaced by a compact primary button. Centred logo only at 390.

patterns.name: Fixed blue bar
patterns.description: 70px #1cb0f6 bar on catalogue and document pages: white logo, white language trigger, white LOGIN (83x44) and green GET STARTED (133x44) buttons; at 390 a 40px menu button opens a three-item popover.

patterns.name: Hero pair
patterns.description: 988px row, justify end, 80px gap: 424px square illustration, then a 480px column with a centred 32px headline and two stacked 330x50 buttons 12px apart.

patterns.name: Course strip
patterns.description: 80px band between 2px rules: 14px arrows either side of a 1002px window of course links (flag 36x28 + 15px uppercase label, 23px gap); arrows page the list with transform 0.5s ease-in-out. Hidden at 390.

patterns.name: Alternating feature rows
patterns.description: Rows of 530px height in the 988px column: 473px copy (48px green lowercase headline, 24px gap, 17px/24px grey body) and a 530px illustration, 101px apart, flipping sides every row. Stacked and centred at 390 with 32px gaps and 96px between rows.

patterns.name: Green site footer
patterns.description: Five 178px columns, 24px gap, 96px top and 64px bottom padding; 35 links in 15px/22px 700 #a5ed6e under #d7ffb8 headings; then a full-width rule and a wrapping 37-entry site-language list (13px, 8px 12px item margins).

patterns.name: Link-row footer
patterns.description: Single centred row of eight uppercase 15px links (12px side margins) under /super, /math, /efficacy and /business; white on dark grounds, #afafaf on white.

patterns.name: Tile grid
patterns.description: Course tiles 200x217 with a 2px rim and 4px floor (#e5e5e5), 16px radius, 88x68 image, 17px name and learner count; four per row at 1440 (222px or 213px tracks), two per row at 390.

layout.responsive: At 390 every two-column row stacks with copy first and centred; display headlines step down (48px to 36px on home, 62px to 44px on /super, 80px to 48px on /business); the course strip and the language trigger disappear; the blue bar and /efficacy collapse their links into a menu button. Buttons grow to the column width (330px or 358px).

components.name: Primary button
components.anatomy: Element with a transparent 4px bottom border; the visible face is a ::before layer (z-index -1) with the fill and a solid 4px box-shadow floor; uppercase label.

spec.radius: 12px on home and course pages, 16px elsewhere

states.name: active
states.change: transform: translateY(4px) and the ::before box-shadow becomes none, so the face drops onto its floor; filter stays brightness(1.1)

components.notes: Blue variant on /math and the sign-in sheet: face #1cb0f6, floor #1899d6.

components.name: Outline button
components.anatomy: Element with 2px 2px 4px transparent borders; ::before at inset -2px with a white fill, 2px #e5e5e5 border and a 2px #e5e5e5 floor.

states.name: active
states.change: transform: translateY(2px) and the ::before box-shadow becomes none; filter stays brightness(0.9)

components.notes: Used for 'I already have an account', store badges (63px tall, 9.5px 14px padding) and sign-in providers.

components.name: Thin-rim outline button
components.anatomy: 1px 1px 5px transparent borders; ::before at inset -1px, white, 1px #e5e5e5 border, box-shadow 0 3px 0 1px #e5e5e5.

components.name: White-faced button on navy
components.anatomy: As the primary button with a white ::before and a 40% white floor; label is gradient text clipped over #042c60.

components.name: Ghost button on navy
components.anatomy: Transparent face, ::before with a 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) rim and 2px floor of the same colour.

components.name: Site-language menu
components.anatomy: Uppercase trigger with a chevron; on hover a popover hangs below it: 411px card, 2px #e5e5e5 border, 15px radius, 15px padding, notch on top, two 188.7px columns of 34 language links (flag + 15px #777777 label, 42px rows, 20px side padding).

spec.trigger: 15px/17.25px 700, letter-spacing 0.8px, #afafaf (#ffffff on the blue bar, #777777 on /math)

states.name: hover (trigger)

states.name: open

states.name: open

principles: Every button stands on a solid floor: the face is a ::before layer with a 4px (or 2px) box-shadow in a darker shade, and pressing moves the button down by exactly that floor and removes it.
No transitions on buttons: hover is a brightness filter and the press is instant.
Headlines in the display face are lowercase and green (navy on white bands, white on colour); everything else is the rounded sans.
All button labels are 15px bold uppercase with 0.8px tracking, centred in fixed-width buttons (330px on home, 300px on /math, 275px on /business, 310px on /super).
Generous white space: 96px to 112px band padding, 530px illustrations beside 473px text columns.
Illustration carries the personality; chrome stays flat with 2px #e5e5e5 rims and no soft shadows.
avoid: Soft or blurred drop shadows; depth is only the solid bottom floor.
Thin hairline borders: rims are 2px (1px only on the /math thin-rim buttons).
Animated button presses with easing; the original press has no transition.
